title: Pilot token-budgeted task-fingerprint retrieval with a fresh helper
description: Run a bounded offline experiment over a frozen recent-task corpus. Generate compact source-linked task fingerprints and deterministic lexical retrieval results, give a fresh visible read-only helper only the compact pilot packet first, monitor its source selections and uncertainty, and compare them with a predeclared truth set and context budget. Do not integrate the prototype into startup, MAP routing, the Command Center, or external services.
acceptance_criteria: The corpus, frozen queries, expected relevant sources, scoring method, and token budget are recorded before the evaluator sees the packet.
Each compact fingerprint links to resolvable primary MAP evidence and the generated pilot remains a disposable projection rather than task or policy authority.
A fresh visible helper evaluates the compact index without broad repository search, writes nothing, reports uncertainty and selected source expansions, and is monitored through hcom.
The final report measures retrieval recall, precision/usefulness, discovery size, source-expansion choices, latency, stale or broken references, and limitations, including negative results.
